remarks: Welcome to this pristine and beautifully maintained Marrano built townhouse offering comfortable, convenient living with plenty of versatile space. A welcoming foyer leads to the bright and open great room which adjoins the kitchen that features white cabinetry, and stainless steel appliances. A nice size dining area features a sliding door that leads to the patio, perfect for enjoying your morning coffee, entertaining guests, or relaxing outdoors. This inviting open floor plan offers a great layout for ease of day to day living and for entertaining for todays sought after lifestyle. Upstairs, you’ll find two comfortable bedrooms, one with a walk-in closet, a full bath and an abundance of closet space! Both bedrooms connect to the full bath. This fabulous 2-bedroom townhouse also features a covered front porch, a convenient attached garage, 1st floor laundry including the washer and dryer, a half bath and full basement. The full basement with glass block windows adds valuable additional space for storage, a home gym, office, hobby area, or future finishing possibilities and the attached garage provides added convenience and protection from the elements. With its pristine condition, open floor plan, the attached garage? and  guest parking conveniently located right across from your driveway, this townhouse offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and low-maintenance living for ease of lifestyle with snow removal,(driveway, walkway and the front porch) lawn cutting, trash collection and water are all included. Central Square villas offer use of the community pool. With a super location near expressways and day to day conveniences, don't miss your wonderful opportunity to make this well-cared-for home your own! .
